about: What port/tools/hostgen/release_carry_rac3.py needs of NTSC-U besides rac3-decomp's tables and rac3-pal's port: the keys of hostgen.json that are this disc's own, the pairs and addresses checked by hand, each with its evidence.

hostgen.about: Keys over rac3-pal's carried hostgen.json (null removes one; a dict is merged unless it has "replace").
hostgen.title: Ratchet & Clank: Up Your Arsenal (NTSC-U)
hostgen.tick_rate_why: The NTSC-U game leaves its settings word 0x00143950 at 0 and takes the 60 Hz branch PAL never takes (rac3-pal/README.md, Ticks): it counts in sixtieths.

hostgen.asm_signatures_why: FontPrint (PAL's func_0038EBC8): host/ui2d.c wraps it as a void function, as PAL's prototype has it; NTSC-U's assembly leaves $v0 as a callee's, which hostgen took for a result; the follow camera's stick read (PAL's func_L01_003E92F8, whose C gives PAL its prototype): host/camera_latch.c wraps it with the camera and the two axes' addresses, NTSC-U's copy being assembly here
hostgen.places_why: NTSC-U's own level catalogue, in its own names: every level function is translated from the disc's level programs (no src/levels C yet: its names and its levels' data are PAL's)
hostgen.split_places_why: NTSC-U's own tables/split_places.tsv: the multiplayer maps' copies of the font width wrapper (func_L01_00410820) are their own function, func_L39_005187A0, whose name the carry leaves out as no function of NTSC-U's catalogue; its signature below, as rac3-pal's func_L39_005189A0
hostgen.executables_why: PAL's multiplayer executable (rac3-pal/mp/hostgen.json, I5BOOTN.ELF) is built for PAL alone: NTSC-U's has not been paired with it yet

pairs.about: Function pairs taken as they are where map.tsv pairs nothing: PAL's name, NTSC-U's, the evidence.
